payload.purpose_context: Addresses operator review of the closed PR #138: the pack descriptor/tactic round-trip gains storage-transparent per-type repositories aggregated into DDD entities, a shared jspecify-only validation module ported from modular-validators for fail-fast guards, Spring bean wiring, and fluent builders — without changing the semantic round-trip invariant or onion layering.
payload.purpose_tldr: Reshape pack read/write into per-type repositories and add a shared fail-fast validation module.

options: Split: records for adapter DTO/DAO, fluent-builder final classes for domain entities
Builders everywhere (final classes + pkg-private ctor), no separate record DTO layer
Records everywhere (public canonical ctor + static factories), drop pkg-private-ctor goal
payload.question: How should the pack types be modelled, reconciling 'fluent builders + package-private full ctor' with 'use records for DTO/DAO'?

payload.final_answer: Option 1 (split), refined to a type-nature hard-and-fast rule: RECORDS for value objects / data structures / parameter & DTO classes (TacticReference, TacticStep, PackPaths, YAML-row DTOs), with a fluent builder added only where a record is still wide; FINAL CLASSES with a public fluent builder + package-private all-args constructor for ENTITIES (identity + invariants + lifecycle: Tactic, the pack aggregate). Readers parse YAML->DTO records, then assemble domain entities via builders. Aligns with the DDD entity/valueObject glossary entries this mission adds.

options: Layer-role rename now, ADR-0006 slices deferred (amend ADR-0006)
Adopt ADR-0006 vertical slices now (packs slice + kernel)
payload.question: How should the screaming-architecture rename reconcile with ADR-0006's proposed vertical-slice (domain-concern) layout?

payload.final_answer: Adopt ADR-0006 vertical-concern slices NOW: restructure into kernel + packs slice modules with ai.speckitty.charter.<concern>.<layer> packages (domain/application/infra.storage/infra.api) + a bootstrap composition root; validation lives kernel-side; whole-service migration accepted (DIRECTIVE_035 occurrence map). The pack descriptor+tactic repositories/validation feature is delivered ON this slice structure.

options: Separate top-level validation module (two inner rings; amend DOMAIN_IS_PURE + ADR-0006)
Nest as kernel.validation inside the single kernel module (broaden ..kernel.domain.. to ..kernel..)
payload.question: Where does the pure validation library live, given ADR-0006 has a single kernel ring and DOMAIN_IS_PURE only admits java + ..kernel.domain.. + own domain?

payload.final_answer: Nest validation inside the single kernel module as ai.speckitty.charter.kernel.validation (NOT a separate top-level module). ADR-0006 single-kernel model unchanged; DOMAIN_IS_PURE broadens ..kernel.domain.. -> ..kernel..; a validation-purity ArchUnit rule gates ..kernel.validation.. -> {java, jspecify} with a known-bad control. The kernel module holds two pure sub-packages: kernel.domain (Pack/DRG vocab) + kernel.validation (guard lib).

reason: Review passed: DSO-based persistence storage. DSOs are flat value-equal records mirroring serialized YAML (order/dup-sensitive lists; pack_level raw token + activeCharter/packDrg/undeclaredKeys). SerializationStrategy interface + YamlSerializationStrategy reusing YamlDumpEmitter/ParsedYaml/PackSchemas/PackDescriptorReader; reads return FileRead (broken file = violation, not exception). FilesystemPackStore: atomic temp->injectable Rename (ATOMIC_MOVE), lexical + realpath/symlink containment, replace-by-id-only (unknown id refused, not created, C-008), partial-tolerant read reporting PackElementViolation, missing/unreadable pack.yaml -> CharterRefusal. Round-trip NON-VACUOUS: literal oracle vs hand-written DSOs (nested ref, duplicate gamma, active_charter, pack_drg), oracle-bites guard, write->fresh-dir refetch-equals (not fetch==refetch - writes into placeholder-only dir), mutation controls (name + pack_level refetch different), undeclared-key capture/drop pin. Write-safety NON-VACUOUS: injected-failing-rename atomicity (temp-seen-mid-write, target bytes unchanged, no stray temp) + real-rename positive control; symlink-escape refused + in-root control same store; replace-by-id-only + control; identifier-escape refused + plain control. Green CONFIRMED: only red is :packs:openPacksRoundTrip, all 12 are the open-packs pin-mismatch guard (pin 01edb4eb, checkout moved), NOT WP10 regressions; force-rerun :packs:test (PackRoundTripTest 7/7, PackWriteSafetyTest 5/5) + :bootstrap:test (HexagonalArchitectureTest 36/36 incl STORAGE_RETURNS_DOMAIN + RESOLVER_OWNS_NETWORK) all pass. NOTE: deliverable auto-commit 0761114 lacks Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers - trailer-fix-at-closeout (known). NOTE: pack_id->directory resolution correctly DEFERRED to WP11 (WP10 uses PackIdentifier value as directory name directly under root - documented + containment-tested, not a hidden defect).

delta.note: Wired DomainRepositoryService @Service + Locations bean in bootstrap; production-path wiring test round-trips through the WIRED bean; green except known pin

reason: Review passed (FR-010/IC-06). PackPersistenceWiring is a @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) in the CharterWiring explicit-@Bean house style: provides a DomainRepositoryService.Locations bean (lambda over CharterWiring.PackLocations, read on every call) and a DomainRepositoryService bean; no domain port/impl touched, no Spring type on any port, no Spring Data. WiringRoundTripTest is @SpringBootTest on CharterServiceApplication, @Autowired of the WIRED TacticRepository/PackRepository by domain port type only, real temp-dir fixture pack via real charter.packs properties; round-trip is non-vacuous (reloaded==renamed AND reloaded.name!=original.name, load-bearing) plus present/absent-id control and PackRepository.load(pack).id()==pack. bootstrap:test --rerun-tasks fully green (WiringRoundTripTest 2/2, plus ProductionWiringTest, HexagonalArchitectureTest/ArchUnit, cucumber Examples) — no duplicate-bean/context-load failure. verifyAll red ONLY on the known open-packs pin-skew tests (checkout d71b2ec vs pin 01edb4e: OpenPacksAcceptance/RoundTrip, ScopeParity, VendoredPacks), an env condition independent of WP12. Anti-pattern checklist all PASS/N/A; trailers present (71b1e7e). @Service/@Bean note: WP11's DomainRepositoryService carries @Service but packs.infra.storage is NOT in the CharterServiceApplication scan base (bootstrap + packs.infra.api only), so the @Service is currently DECORATIVE and WP12 wires via explicit @Bean (consistent with the bootstrap house style). Green with no duplicate bean; genuinely cosmetic. Approved as (a) with a RECONCILE-AT-PRE-PR note: at mission convergence, drop the unscanned @Service on DomainRepositoryService (WP11-owned file) to leave the explicit @Bean as the single wiring signal. First non-framework consumer of the bean lands in WP13.
